rca_of_issue: PromoBanner and CategoryBox nav were unconditionally rendered when configShowPromotionsOnMenu/configShowCategories were true, even during active search. Mobile keyboard pushed these elements up, hiding search results. Fix: added `&& !searchQuery` to both conditions so they disappear when user is searching.
